Authorities Launch Large-Scale Sapling Plantation Drives

Authorities in Bangalore and Nanded have initiated significant sapling plantation drives. The Bangalore Development Authority is defending its project to plant 15 lakh saplings, emphasizing the need for scientific monitoring and stating it's too early to assess success. In Nanded, the district administration has launched a separate initiative to plant one lakh bamboo saplings.
